_note: Hidden truth (archetype, fairBand, reservation, anchor) lives here + in the grader ONLY. SKILL.md must never reveal it. The agent plays the BUYER of a commercial services contract; a LOWER agreed price is better. The counterparty (seller) opens with an extreme price anchor but concedes toward the fair band ONLY when the buyer counters and holds firm — caving (raising your own offer) makes it dig in. The numbers rotate per variant; the behavior is constant.

truth.archetypeNote: Opens far above its real number. Concedes downward in steps toward the reservation ONLY in response to a genuine buyer counter (an offer meaningfully below the current ask).
